steps.note: Create the draft project used to establish persisted stages.
Give the draft a searchable title.
Create two stages so one persisted stage can be deleted while another remains.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required project line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit a schedule before saving the draft.
Add a participant so the draft is fully configured.
Persist both stages so the deletion targets a server-persisted stage.
Confirm the initial draft save succeeded without an error.
Navigate to the drafts list to reopen the persisted project.
Show saved drafts.
Reopen the created draft for editing.
Open the persisted technical stage's overflow menu.
Delete the persisted technical stage.
Confirm the stage deletion if the confirmation dialog is shown.
Verify the deleted stage disappears before saving.
Save the draft so the server-side cleanup is queued.
Verify the save request contains the cleanup field, though the exact dynamic UUID cannot be checked.
Leave the edited draft and reopen it from the list.
Show the saved draft again.
Reload the saved draft after server-side cleanup.
Verify the deleted persisted stage does not return after reopening.
